overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the July 26, 2012 notice listed the license report with enough specificity, and the Town Manager's memorandum related to that properly noticed item.

allegations.summary: Complaint that the July 26, 2012 meeting notice did not list with sufficient specificity the topics the Chair anticipated discussing.
allegations.key_passage: Following our review, we find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law because its July 26, 2012 meeting notice listed with sufficient specificity the topics the Chair reasonably anticipated discussing.

allegations.summary: Complaint that the Town Manager introduced an undisclosed agenda item, a seventeen-page memorandum on cancelling four liquor licenses, that did not appear on the notice.
allegations.key_passage: however we find that the Town Manager's recommendations were related to a properly noticed item on the agenda.
